about.body: The Ford Duratorq engine fitted to the XF is a 2.2-litre inline-four diesel from Ford's Puma family, produced from 2008 to 2015. It was used in the X250-generation XF as the entry-level diesel option, offering a balance of economy and performance for the saloon body style. This engine is Ford-sourced rather than a Jaguar-designed unit, which means its parts and maintenance patterns align with Ford's Duratorq family rather than Jaguar's Ingenium or AJD diesel lines.

byModel.body: The Ford Duratorq appears in a single Jaguar application: the XF 2.2D (X250, 2008-2015) . It was the diesel option for the first-generation XF before the Ingenium diesel family replaced it in the X260 generation. We work on this engine across all X250 XF 2.2D variants.

compatibility.body: Because the Ford Duratorq appears in only one Jaguar application - the XF 2.2D (X250, 2008-2015) - compatibility matching is more straightforward than with engines that span multiple models. However, registration/VIN matching is still required to confirm exact ancillaries, ECU calibration, and year-specific variations. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
